title: Cohomology factorization of the affine algebra derived counit
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism [def-pc-scheme], and $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,f_*\mathcal O_X)$ its canonical morphism [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Let $P:\operatorname{Mod}(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] preserve finite limits, with an adjunction $a:P\dashv g_*$. Let $L:D(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] have an adjunction $b:L\dashv Rg_*$ to [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. For any $K$ with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category] and integer $n$, there is an isomorphism $e:H^n(L Rg_*K)\cong P g_*H^n(K)$ such that $H^n(b_K)=e\,;\,a_{H^n(K)}$, where $b_K$ and $a_{H^n(K)}$ denote the respective counit components.

proof.text: Scalar restriction T from f_*O_X to O_Y is exact and reflects isomorphisms, because its composite with the underlying-sheaf functor is the same underlying-sheaf functor. The right-derived/exact-functor comparison and the composition comparison identify Rg_* followed by RT with Rf_*; underived g_* followed by T equals f_*. Choose the standard derived category on the auxiliary category of O_Y-modules; the original universe parameters are unchanged.

Apply the affine unbounded cohomology formula to Rf_*E, and the exact-functor homology comparison to T. Quasi-coherence over f_*O_X is equivalent to quasi-coherence after restriction to O_Y, by the affine module correspondence. Consequently Rg_*E has quasi-coherent algebra cohomology whenever E has quasi-coherent cohomology.

Positive higher direct images of quasi-coherent modules vanish for affine f. Apply the natural unbounded cohomology comparison for acyclic quasi-coherent pushforward. If Rg_*u is invertible for a map u between quasi-coherent complexes, then RT(Rg_*u), hence Rf_*u, is invertible. Naturality of the comparison makes f_*H^i(u) invertible. Exact conservative scalar restriction reflects this to g_*H^i(u). Apply P and naturality of its underived counit, whose components on H^i(E) and H^i(F) are invertible, to obtain invertibility of H^i(u). The derived-category homology criterion gives invertibility of u.

At M=Rg_*K, the existing derived unit homology factorization and the underived unit isomorphisms make every cohomology map of the derived unit invertible. Thus that unit is invertible. The right triangle identity implies that Rg_* of the derived counit at K is invertible. Both its endpoints have quasi-coherent cohomology, using preservation by derived pullback and Step 2, so Step 3 reflects this to invertibility of the derived counit.

The ordinary counit at H^n(K) is invertible. Define e as the isomorphism of H^n of the derived counit, followed by the inverse of the ordinary counit isomorphism. Associativity and inverse cancellation give exactly the required factorization. No specified canonical comparison is part of the existential conclusion. This does not invoke the derived counit factorization or the derived adjunction isomorphisms as a dependency.

theorem affine_algebra_derived_counit_homology_factorization
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    (P : SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (a : P ⊣ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
    [Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits P]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (adj : L ⊣ RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
          (L.obj ((RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage
            (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj K)) ≅
        P.obj ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K)),
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).map
          (adj.counit.app K) =
        e.hom ≫ a.counit.app ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K)
